notes:
Live NetSuite SuiteCommerce Advanced (SCA) storefront, boutique luxury home-furnishings/collectibles/gift retailer. Direct fetch (plain requests, curl, curl_cffi, r.jina.ai, translate.goog) all return an empty pre-render shell (
) because the entire catalogue is client-side rendered via a Backbone.js app hitting XHR endpoints that could not be reverse-engineered from the minified bundle in the time available; the homepage's larger HTML is only CMS marketing content, not product data. WebFetch (which executes JS) was the only working route and reliably surfaced the site's own '#### N Products' listing-header total for each category page -- used as the qty evidence throughout (Rule 1: rendered header). Access became increasingly unreliable over the session (site/Cloudflare appears to rate-limit or intermittently fail to complete the async product-grid XHR before WebFetch snapshots the page, consistent with the brief's 'sites hard-block by IP after sustained access' warning) -- roughly a quarter of targeted leaf categories (16 of 64) could not be verified after 2-3 retries each and are recorded as qty:null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag and their canonical URL, per Rule 1 ('a null is a correct answer'). Reused prior worker's w80 scratchpad leads (coll_bear.html, herend_bear.html, pet.html, sealife.html, morefig.html pointed at Herend figurine sub-lines) as a starting map only; none of those saved files contained usable counts (empty shells), so every qty here was freshly verified via WebFetch, none copied from the prior attempt. Extracted only genuinely decorative product-type nodes per the WHAT TO EXTRACT rules: Lighting (Luxury Lamps, all fixture types), Mirrors, Clocks (all types), Picture Frames, the decorative subset of Home Decor Accessories (trays, paintings & prints, decorative fire screens, vases/cachepots), the decorative subset of Office Accessories (bookends, globes, paperweights -- excluded Desk Organizer Set and 'More Office Accessories' as functional/mixed leather-desk-goods, not decor, confirmed by inspecting product titles which were pen sets, leather boxes, magnifying glasses), and the Collectibles department's decorative sculpture/figurine/box lines (Austrian Bronzes, Handcrafted Sculptures, Handpainted Porcelain, Halcyon Days enamel boxes, Pewter Art, Herend Figurines) since the brief explicitly includes 'decorative accessories: ...sculptures, figurines'. Excluded throughout: Furniture, Jewelry, Gift Ideas, Inspiration, New Arrivals, Wedding Registry, CatalogRequest (all NEVER-EXTRACT nav/marketing or out-of-scope departments); Holiday Decor and every holiday-themed sub-line (Christmas/Easter/Halloween Pewter, Holiday Figurines, Holidays & Annual Boxes) per the Holiday exclusion; Leather Accessories (jewelry cases, travel organizers -- personal leather goods, not home decor); Home Decor Accessories' Pillows, Throw Blankets, Wall Tapestries, Wallpaper (textiles/wallcoverings, explicitly excluded) and Coffee Table Books (books, not a decor product type); Halcyon Days' Handpainted/Hinged Bangles and Scarves (jewelry/apparel, not decor); Tabletop (China, Crystal & Glassware, Silver, Flatware & Serving, Barware) was reviewed and dropped in its entirety -- every one of its sub-nodes is a brand/designer listing (Baccarat, Waterford, Herend China, Christofle, etc.) or a 'Shop All' rollup, both explicitly excluded as 'not categories' under the brief's NEVER-EXTRACT rule, and the un-branded remainder (flatware, barware) is explicitly excluded as cutlery/bar tools. Rule 0.6 overlaps documented: (1) Mirrors' four sub-nodes (Ornate 60 + Rectangular 80 + Round 27 + Nature [unverified]) sum to well over the 'Shop All Mirrors' aggregate of 145, meaning the site cross-lists mirrors under overlapping shape facets -- kept all four as genuine nav branches per Rule 0.6 rather than treating as a clean partition. (2) The top-level /herend/scully-halycon-exclusives page (35 Products) and /collectibles/halcyon-days/scully-halycon-exclusives page (35 Products) returned identical counts and the same 'Halcyon Days Scully & Scully Exclusives' collection description -- treated as the SAME underlying category mis-linked into both nav trees (the Herend menu's slug literally reuses the Halcyon Days slug, unlike the correctly-named /collectibles/herend-figurines/scully-herend-exclusives sibling used elsewhere); kept it once, filed under Halcyon Days, and dropped it from the Herend Figurines list to avoid double-counting. Herend Figurines top total (Shop-All-Herend) reads 1223 Products across all 12 sub-lines including Holiday; the 10 kept non-holiday, non-duplicate leaves verified individually sum to 1174, consistent with the remainder belonging to Holiday Figurines (excluded) and Pet Figurines (unverified, null).
